reference_origin: 本项目生成的测试入口概念图，非源 X 演示图。
annotation_method: Deterministic SVG overlays on byte-identical embedded original PNG files; manually selected boxes in original image pixels.
assessment_scope: Visual observations only; no author intent inferred, no automatic alignment and no fabricated error or similarity score.

priority_gaps.title: 咖啡店上层：一个主窗的节奏
priority_gaps.reference_observation: 参考图可见咖啡店上层以一个较突出的大窗为主，两侧有较宽墙面。
priority_gaps.v4_observation: V4 咖啡店上层呈现两个近似等宽窗，与另外两店形成重复的双窗节奏。
priority_gaps.direction: 仅重排、缩放既有窗组及墙段，尝试形成一个主窗的视觉重心。
priority_gaps.acceptance: 主机位能清楚读出一个咖啡店主窗；不保留第二个明显开口或产生穿墙。

priority_gaps.title: 门窗比例：减轻横向装饰
priority_gaps.reference_observation: 参考图的门窗与墙面比例更有变化，店招和层间线脚较克制。
priority_gaps.v4_observation: V4 上层窗、门脸呈较统一的模块比例；层间、檐下和店招横条更厚、更突出。
priority_gaps.direction: 只调整既有窗框、门脸与横向线脚的尺度和位置，让开口与墙面占比更自然。
priority_gaps.acceptance: 横条不再压过门窗；保留窗洞、玻璃与框架对齐，室内可读。

priority_gaps.title: 屋顶轮廓：打破一条连续斜线
priority_gaps.reference_observation: 参考图屋顶有分段与局部高低变化，第三店屋顶附近可见小山墙轮廓。
priority_gaps.v4_observation: V4 三店屋顶和屋檐接近一条连续、统一的斜线，分段变化较弱。
priority_gaps.direction: 重排既有屋顶、檐线或顶端构件，尝试分段及第三店局部山墙感。
priority_gaps.acceptance: 主视角能读出分段轮廓；不用新增网格补细节，不引入明显断缝。

out_of_scope.name: 水面反光
out_of_scope.note: 两图反光表现不同，本轮不改水面、灯光或材质。

out_of_scope.name: 远景
out_of_scope.note: V4 背景建筑与岸线收尾较简化，本轮保持不变。

allowed_changes: Reposition or scale existing architectural components
Rearrange existing architectural vertices without adding topology
acceptance: Compare each of the three annotated architectural gaps at the unchanged V4 camera
Check window/frame/glass alignment and roof/facade continuity
Keep both improvements and regressions visible; stop after at most two low-resolution previews
